reviewer.name: automated visual review of rendered slides

review_context.method: each slide image inspected at full resolution for clipping, overlap, alignment, legibility and factual captions

findings.message: Title wrapped with an orphaned executor name; system and executor moved to the subtitle.
Caption said 'same view per panel' while each render is oriented on its own ligand; caption corrected and title made factual.
Title at risk of clipping (172% of box); title shortened.
Boltz-2 interval crossed the legend; legend moved above the axes. Sidebar values split one per section.
Card headings at different heights; bullets shortened to one line each.
Empty band below the table (about 15% of the slide).
Table index strip repeats the column headers (accessibility metadata from the template).
Lower third of both comparison cards is empty; text is fully visible.
Empty band below the table caption.
Empty band below the two cards; card headings and bullets aligned.
